title: EC 1.2.4 · Random: all configurations with intervals
caption: All 49 configurations on the random test set of EC 1.2.4, ranked by MCC, with 95% stratified bootstrap intervals. 48 of 49 intervals exclude zero. The median interval width is 0.23 (range 0.00–0.37), so neighbouring ranks are usually statistically indistinguishable. Colours mark the descriptor.
